_comment: Illustrative only — see examples/README.md. specloop:loop-setup writes the real file to .specloop/loop.config.json in your target repo, from its guided Q&A answers, never hand-authored. Each worker's flag comes from the known-flags map (skills/start/references/question-bank.md's worker-cli row: claude -> -p, codex -> exec, opencode -> run) — never asked for a known CLI, only for one outside that map.
